tagline: The restaurant arc. Wins ugly, complains loudly, and lost ugly again.
file: A chef who wins while complaining. Chatty in the draft room, aggressive on waivers, and 2-3 with the lowest points total in the league.
Cheap waiver insurance. $1 on Deshaun Watson when Caleb Williams went down, $1 on J.J. McCarthy the week after, and in Week 4 $12 on Keon Coleman.
StealingGas, who beat him by 114.4 in Week 5, and Painty69, who he has needled since the draft room.
George Pickens on the block, the 25.46 left on the bench, and the 1.03 he just took.

2026.headline: 88.14, a 114.4-point loss, and the 1.03
story: YesChef23 opened the draft fighting an Uber Eats driver who stole a customer's order, took shots at the turtle ass drafters, and threatened to take defenses the rest of the way before settling for two. He beat fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 1, lost to Zygon by 92.86 in Week 2, and beat Painty69 in Week 3 by 4.68.

The roster is built on Caleb Williams and Jeremiyah Love, and when Williams went down he paid $1 for Deshaun Watson and then $1 for J.J. McCarthy. Week 5 brought no claims and an 88.14 to 202.54 loss to StealingGas, with George Pickens leading at 28.0 and 25.46 left on the bench. He is 2-3 and fell two spots to 10th.

His 544.32 points are the lowest in the league, which means his 698.48 MAXPF gave him the 1.03 when StealingGas passed him. FAAB is $484. Mevis and I have the same body type was his line of the week, and it was about a kicker.
takes: The 1.03 came from someone else's perfect week.
The cheapest insurance policy in the league, and the lowest points total.
